record.chaining: Unlimited free accounts x 60 storage minutes. A video-minute is a terrible unit for binary storage: 60 min at 1080p is ~1-4 GB and everything is transcoded, never stored as original bytes.
record.limits_note: 60 storage mins, 100 GB/mo bandwidth, 60 mins live streaming. All assets transcoded to adaptive bitrate.
record.reliability_note: Transcodes by design; originals are not the delivered artifact. Unusable for byte-exact storage.
